purpose: Applies the FASB proposed Update of 2026-08-18 (Statement of Cash Flows (Topic 230): Cash Equivalents-Disclosure Enhancement and Evaluation of Certain Digital Assets, exposure draft, comments due 2026-11-19) to the DECLARED redemption and reserve terms of one stablecoin holding, criterion by criterion, and returns per-criterion PASS / FAIL / NOT_DETERMINABLE verdicts, a collective classification (MEETS_PROPOSED_EXAMPLES / DOES_NOT_MEET / NOT_DETERMINABLE) always labelled with the proposal status, the disclosure checklist the text proposes, and a Policy Mandate export of the declared terms and result. Inputs are declared terms only: direct issuer redemption right, on-demand redeemability, known redemption amount, gates or suspension terms, intermediary-only access, segregated one-to-one short-term liquid reserves, original maturity, and a declared law-or-regulation prohibition term. Secondary-market salability alone never qualifies (the pinned Case-B boundary). Significance thresholds for fees and minimums are declared policy parameters, not values from the text. SCOPE LIMITS: the node evaluates declared terms only and never says how an entity must account, presenting a qualifying asset as a cash equivalent is an accounting policy election; this page is not an accounting opinion. Issuer reserve adequacy and issuer disclosure evidence is served by other estate nodes (art-06, art-275, art-582); this node consumes no issuer evidence. Refuses any input outside the declared shape; a missing (as opposed to type-invalid) required term yields NOT_DETERMINABLE, not a guess.
